label: Atmosphere
description: Observatories of the atmosphere: greenhouse-gas concentrations, atmospheric chemistry, deposition, radiation and surface meteorology (e.g. ICOS atmosphere stations).

label: Cryosphere
description: Observatories of snow, ice, glaciers, permafrost and polar systems.

label: Terrestrial / Ecological
description: Ecological observatories on land: forests, grasslands, shrublands, alpine and urban systems, including flux towers and long-term plots.

label: Arid
description: Observatories of arid, semi-arid and desert systems: hot and cold deserts, dryland shrublands and grasslands.

label: Agriculture
description: Observatories of croplands, managed grasslands and agro-ecosystems.

label: Aquatic — Ocean & Estuarine
description: Observatories of the ocean, coasts and estuaries.

label: Aquatic — Freshwater
description: Observatories of streams, rivers, lakes and wetlands.
